summary: This is a single Secure Agility camera at Kingsway/Central Rd, Miranda. It went dark from 2024-08-28 to 2024-09-17 (already set missing) and came back with redrawn zones: the two Kingsway south footpath zones (371, 373) had counted almost nothing before this and are set missing, and the road (369), crossing (370) and Westfield entrance (372) zones change level and profile, so each direction is split into pre- and post-2024-09-18 series. Holiday-period false detections in footpath zone 371 (2024-12-29, 2024-12-31, 2025-01-02 to 01-05) are set missing; the 2024-11-03 early-morning westbound surge (1734 on the road, 887 on the footpath) is kept as a real organised ride.
